description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Holy], [Damage Cap +10000], [Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 75%], [Judgment Mode] and [Unwavering Justice Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Holy
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Holy damage capped at 99999

description.name: Judgment Mode
description.text: Grants [Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 125%]/[Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 200%]/[Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 300%] after using 1/2/3+ Holy abilities

description.name: Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 125%
description.text: Returns 125% of the damage taken to the attacker as Holy damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 200%
description.text: Returns 200% of the damage taken to the attacker as Holy damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Holy Radiant Shield: 300%
description.text: Returns 300% of the damage taken to the attacker as Holy damage capped at 99999

description.name: Unwavering Justice Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Unwavering Justice after using four Holy abilities

description.name: Unwavering Justice
description.text: One single attack (22.00) capped at 99999, grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user
